bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; appropriating money for floodplain management.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$190,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $190,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Water and Soil Resources for grants to Area II Minnesota River Basin Projects for floodplain management.
